mechanism_narrative: A lower level of the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Rank IC between FEDFUNDS level and 20-day forward returns is less than 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the unemployment rate above 4.0% signals deteriorating labor market conditions that may lead to economic contraction, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative when UNRATE exceeds 4.0% (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous acceleration in labor market strength (PAYEMS growth > 0.5%) and industrial production (INDPRO growth > 0.3%) signals robust economic expansion, which may lead to monetary tightening and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The interaction effect between PAYEMS and INDPRO growth is not significant (p > 0.05) in predicting negative returns, or Rank IC for the combined signal is below 0.04 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During a monetary tightening cycle, a federal funds rate above 3.0% compresses corporate profit margins and increases discount rates, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative when FEDFUNDS exceeds 3.0% during a monetary tightening cycle (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A higher unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals economic weakness and potential for monetary easing, which compresses discount rates and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns do not exhibit a positive correlation with UNRATE level (Rank IC < 0.05) over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in housing starts below 1500 thousand units signals a contraction in the residential sector, which is a leading indicator of economic slowdown, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are not significantly negative when HOUST falls below 1500.0 (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC falls below 0.04 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous acceleration in industrial production (INDPRO growth > 0.2%) and inflation (CPIAUCSL growth > 0.3%) signals an overheating economy that may trigger aggressive monetary tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The interaction effect between INDPRO and CPIAUCSL growth is not significant (p > 0.05) in predicting negative returns, or Rank IC for the combined signal is below 0.04 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During a late-cycle expansion, weak retail sales (RSAFS < 520,000 million) indicate slowing consumer demand and potential recession, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are not significantly negative when RSAFS falls below 520,000 million during a late-cycle expansion (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
